slug: 2026-01-01 Starlink Partners with Airtel & Vodacom From Rival to Ally

facts.fact: The article lists Mozambique among the 25 African countries where Starlink operates as of November 2025, covered by the Vodacom partnership under which Vodacom is authorised to resell Starlink equipment and broadband services (the resale authorisation is stated generally, not for Mozambique alone).

systems.tiers: enterprise, SMB, rural communities via Vodacom resale

note: Direct-to-cell and backhaul parts are not facts; Airtel D2C does not name Mozambique.
